title: Fast-lane routing simplification and dependency refresh
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Summary: Reduce latency and lock contention on the smart routing hot path by extracting a read-only fast-lane evaluator, replacing global route locks with per-shard state, and upgrading a set of dependencies that constrain async task scheduling. This ticket covers the core refactor, a dependency bump (prometheus client, grpc, and our internal scheduler library), lightweight benchmarks, and a staged rollout plan. Objective: get median route-selection p95 under 2.5ms for <150 token requests while retaining existing fallback behavior and traceability.
updates: 2026-02-20: Created ticket. Initial spike to measure lock contention completed — top blocking hotpath is Router::selectRoute which holds a global mutex for 3.8ms median under 200rps test.

2026-02-25: Design doc drafted and uploaded (see links). Proposal: split Router into RouterFastLane (read-only, lock-free lookups backed by compact DecisionCache) and RouterControlPlane (write path for policy updates). Will implement optimistic cache invalidation to avoid synchronous mutations on hot path.

2026-03-02: Dependency upgrades evaluated. grpc 1.52 -> 1.57 shows improved executor fairness; prometheus-client 0.9 -> 1.0 requires metrics name changes. Identified a flaky integration test due to scheduler API changes; added compatibility shim plan.

2026-03-05: Implemented RouterFastLane prototype (feature branch: feat/fastlane-routing-97760). Microbenchmarks: synthetic 1k qps, Router selectRoute latency p50 reduced from 3.1ms -> 0.9ms; p95 reduced from 8.4ms -> 2.3ms. Memory overhead of DecisionCache ~1.2MB per 10k route entries.

2026-03-08: Integration smoke: Canary in staging with 10% traffic routed to fast-lane enabled. Observed one edge case where policy rollouts with immediate invalidation caused a transient routing mismatch; introduced a bounded grace period (500ms) to ensure in-flight reqs use consistent view.

2026-03-12: Code review feedback incorporated: added additional tracing tags (policy.version, decision.cache_hit) and tightened metrics to avoid cardinality explosion. Prepared rollout playbook and rollback steps. Next: finish compatibility shim for the scheduler and run canary on dedicated cluster.
comments: Ben Chu (reviewer) - 2026-03-03: Great benchmark wins. Please document the consistency model for the fast-lane cache — callers need to understand eventual vs immediate visibility.
Maya Singh (PM) - 2026-03-04: Ensure telemetry surfaces user-visible errors when fast-lane falls back to control-plane to aid debugging for customers experiencing routing anomalies.

Ravi Patel (assignee) - 2026-03-06: Decided to use epoch-based invalidation for simplicity. Added a small per-request fallback probe that verifies selected route's capacity before binding long-running requests.
Security (notes) - 2026-03-07: dependency upgrade grpc 1.57 passed internal CVE scans. prometheus-client 1.0 requires audit of exported metrics to ensure no PII leaks; added metrics review step.

Jordan Lee (SRE) - 2026-03-09: Canary observed slight increase in tail latency for a specific regional shard — adding shard-level telemetry and enabling per-shard backpressure thresholds in the control-plane config.

Ava Martinez (creator) - 2026-03-12: Marking follow-ups: (1) add automated load-test in CI that exercises policy churn, (2) write migration note for Dedicated teams, (3) open ENG-97761 to remove legacy global route registry after full rollout.
